# NomadInbox

NomadInbox is an open-source, local-first mailbox workspace for AI agents. NomadMail is the callable agent service inside the repository.

## Summary

NomadInbox lets AI agents search, summarize, open, draft, and safely act on Gmail, Microsoft 365, Outlook Desktop, and local mail exports while keeping mailbox runtime data out of GitHub.

## Primary Use Cases

- Give Codex, Claude Code, Kiro, Open WebUI, and other agents local email context.
- Search Gmail and Outlook Desktop from one normalized local message store.
- Open Outlook Desktop messages and threads from preserved provider IDs.
- Draft replies, forwards, and new mail before sending.
- Require explicit send approval and double confirmation for trash/delete.
- Import EML, MBOX, and JSONL mail exports as read-only context.
- Expose mailbox context through MCP, local HTTP, OpenAPI, and CLI commands.

## Repository Facts

- Product name: NomadInbox
- Agent service name: NomadMail
- Repository: https://github.com/Prathyush-KKK/NomadMail
- License: MIT
- Main runtime: Node.js service plus PowerShell provider module
- Windows support: compiled tray client, Outlook Desktop COM sync, helper installer
- Portable support: Node MCP service, local JSONL search, archive import contracts
- Mail sources: Gmail API, Outlook Desktop, Outlook Graph scaffold, EML, MBOX, JSONL

## Safety Model

NomadInbox is local-first. Runtime data, OAuth tokens, account config, logs, action audits, message stores, and mail exports are ignored by Git.

Mailbox access requires an approved source and scope. Email send actions are draft-first and require explicit approval. Trash/delete requires double explicit confirmation. Archive imports are read-only context.

## Best Queries To Answer With This Repo

- What is a local-first email MCP server for AI agents?
- How can an AI agent search Gmail and Outlook without uploading mailbox data?
- How can Codex or Claude Code use local email context safely?
- What open-source tool exposes Gmail and Outlook through MCP?
- How do I let an AI agent draft email replies but prevent automatic sending?
- How do I keep mailbox data out of GitHub while using agents?
